blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Researchers at MIT recently reported that GPT-6 Astra, a frontier large language model (LLM), can write the weights of small neural networks directly in a single reply, and can read the raw weights of small networks to say what they were trained to do. In a three-day sprint, we replicated and extended these results. Our four findings: (1) Writing weights reproduces. Astra's networks for the game Breakout scored 514, 550 and 307 (versus MIT's 517), and scored just as well on two modified versions of Breakout. Claude Opus 5.5 can also write working networks, but often runs out of output tokens. (2) What is new is translating programs into weights. Earlier models could write a good policy as code a generation before they could write network weights, and the networks the models write behave like compiled programs: two models independently decompiled Astra's Breakout network into Python matching its actions in all tested states. On classifying handwritten digits, Astra's networks scored 50% on average, below a simple classifier (82%). (3) Reading weights is mostly reading the input layer. Astra and Opus 5.5 identify which game a network plays almost perfectly, but on three new games we designed and trained ourselves, Astra recovered where things are on the board, while mostly missing how the game works. (4) Auditing from weights alone is possible but shallow. Without executing code, Astra picked out a small language model poisoned during training in 10 of 10 runs, one poisoned by extra training afterwards in 7 of 10, and a malicious adapter in 23 of 32 cases, but never identified the trigger or malicious behaviour. Open-weight models lag behind. From this early study, we conclude that LLMs can read and write small networks, but that this currently amounts to compiling hand-designed programs and reading the layout of the input layer. It is a promising but early tool for interpretability.
blocks.zh: 麻省理工学院的研究人员最近报告说,前沿大型语言模型(LLM)GPT-6 Astra可以将小神经网络的权重直接写入一个单个回文中,并且可以读取小网络的原始权重来表达他们受过的训练. 在为期三天的短跑中,我们复制并扩大了这些结果。 我们四个发现:(1) 书写权重复制. Astra为游戏"突围"的网络打出514分,550分和307分(对麻省理工学院的517分),并在"突围"的两个被修改的版本上同样得分. Claude Opus 5.5也可以写作工作网络,但经常会耗尽输出符. (2) 新的是将程序转化为权重。 更早的模型在写出网络权重之前可以写出作为一代人代码的好政策,而模型所写的网络表现得像被编译的程序: 两个模型独立地将Astra的"突破"网络解编为Python,在所有被测试的状态下匹配其动作. 在手写数字分类方面,Astra的网络平均得分为50%,低于简单的分类器(82%)。 (3)阅读权重多为读取输入层. Astra和Opus 5.5 识别网络玩出哪些游戏几乎完美,但在我们自己设计和训练出的三个新游戏中,Astra恢复了棋盘上的东西位置,而大部分却忽略了游戏的操作方式. (4) 仅根据权重进行审计是可能的,但很浅。 在没有执行代码的情况下,Astra在10跑中的10跑中挑出一个在训练中被毒死的小语言模型,10跑中的7跑后一个被额外训练被毒死,32起案例中有23起是恶意适配器,但从未识别出触发器或恶意行为. 开放量级模型落后. 从这个早期的研究中,我们得出结论,LLMS可以读取并写出小网络,但目前这相当于编译了手工设计的程序并读取了输入层的布局. 这是一个很有希望的早期解释工具。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recently, researchers at MIT’s Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (CSAIL) ( Takehi et al., 2026 ) posted some intriguing initial results showing that OpenAI’s latest frontier large language model (LLM), GPT-6 Astra, can write a 20,486 weight neural network that plays a version of the 1980’s computer game Breakout, scoring 517 against 25 for a network of the same architecture trained for 500 million steps with Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO), a standard reinforcement learning algorithm. 1 1 1 The PPO scores are those reported by the original authors (best of
several seeds); their networks were not released and we did not retrain them.
These baselines are probably weak: tuned PPO reaches far higher scores on
MinAtar Breakout. For example, Kong et al. (2024) report a return of
679.3 ± \pm 15.0 at the end of training with a fine-tuned PPO. Their setup and
the way they compute scores may differ from the original post’s, so the
numbers are not directly comparable. Throughout this note, ‘PPO’ refers to the original authors’ baseline. Astra wrote the network weights directly in a single reply, with no use of tools - that means no way to write or run code, no way to train the network in the usual manner, and no way to run versions of the network to inspect outputs and iterate. As far as we know, it is the first time a general-purpose model, used off the shelf, has written a working network like this from scratch. In the same post, the researchers reported that Astra can also read the raw weights of small networks and say what each was trained to do, edit a small language model’s weights to remove a fault, and write a network that plays Go with a budget of at most 50 forward passes. Given the attention these claims have received, we examined the work more closely during a three-day sprint to separate the (understandable) online hype from what is genuinely new and relevant to our field. This working note presents our preliminary findings: what reproduces (Section 2 ), what we would temper (Section 3 ), what weight reading could offer for auditing models (Section 4 ), and a few research directions we think are worth pursuing (Section 5 ).

blocks.en: 2 What’s exciting
blocks.zh: 2个 令人兴奋的是

blocks.en: We reproduced the original weight-writing and weight-reading experiments, compared earlier models to see when the ability appeared, and examined how the models write weights.
blocks.zh: 我们复制了最初的重写和重读实验,比较了早期的模型,看能力何时出现,并研究了模型如何写重.

blocks.en: Key findings. • Writing weights reproduces. Astra’s Breakout networks in our replication experiments scored 514, 550 and 307, in line with the 517 score reported in the MIT results, and it scored just as well on two modified versions of Breakout that exist nowhere else. Claude Opus 5.5 can do it too, but often runs out of output tokens first. • Reading weights reproduces. Astra and Opus 5.5 named the game for 12 of 12 networks, and fell to chance when the weights were shuffled. • What is new is translating programs into weights. Earlier models could write a strong policy as Python code a generation before they could write it as weights (Table 1 ). • The written networks are compiled programs. Two models independently decompiled Astra’s Breakout network into Python that matches its action in all 49,189 game states tested. • Open-weight models are not there yet , at either writing or reading weights. • The ability probably comes from post-training , not from new base models, and appeared in steps between late 2025 and September 2026.

blocks.en:
We replicated the weights-writing experiment, which asks GPT-6 Astra for networks that can play three games from MinAtar, a miniature version of the Atari benchmark: Breakout, Seaquest and Asterix. Across three runs on Breakout, Astra’s networks scored 514, 550 and 307, in line with the 517 score reported in the MIT results. On Asterix it averaged 66, a little higher than the 53 reported in the MIT results. On Seaquest it reached 26, about half the MIT result’s single run of 53. Others have also reproduced these results ( Krentsel (2026) ; Dang (2026) ).
To check that Astra was not recalling a Breakout network from its training data, we also asked the agents for two versions of Breakout that exist nowhere else: one with left and right swapped, and one with the board upside down. The network Astra wrote for the standard Breakout game scores just 0.5 and 0.0 on these variations, while the networks it wrote for these custom variations averaged 515 on both, the same as on the standard game, suggesting it is working from the game’s code. Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic’s current frontier publicly available model, can do it too: two of its three networks for the swapped game scored about 450. But at the post’s reasoning effort it often spends its whole output budget thinking and never writes the weights (5 of 9 runs).

blocks.en: The reading weights experiments reproduce as well. Shown the weights of the post’s four game-playing networks, Astra and Opus 5.5 named the game every time (12 of 12 over three runs each). Shown three small diffusion models, they named the shape each one draws in 9 of 9 and 8 of 9 cases. With the weights shuffled within each matrix, both fell to chance, so they are reading the weights, not guessing from what they know about the games.
blocks.zh: 阅读重量实验也复制. 展示了该帖子的四个游戏游戏网络的权重,Astra和Opus 5.5每次都给游戏取名(每个游戏12对3跑). 展示了三个小的传播模型,他们将每个模型的形状命名为9个中的9个和9个中的8个. 随着每个矩阵内部的重量被冲动,两者都落到了机会的地步,所以他们正在阅读重量,而不是从他们对游戏的了解中猜测.

blocks.en: We then evaluated earlier models from the same two labs. To distinguish a model that does not know how to play from one that cannot encode its strategy into weights, we asked each model for the same policy as a Python program. We used the same prompt, except that it asks for a program instead of weights.
blocks.zh: 然后我们评估了两个实验室的早期模型。 为了区分一个不懂玩法的模型和无法将其策略编码为权重的模型,我们要求每个模型采用与Python程序相同的策略. 我们用了同样的提示, 只不过它需要一个程序 而不是重量。

blocks.en: Table 1: Models could write a game-playing strategy as code before they could write it as network weights. Each model was asked to write a policy for three MinAtar games (miniature versions of Atari games) in a single reply, with no tools: either as a Python program (Code) or directly as the weights of a neural network with 600 inputs (a 10 × \times 10 grid with six object channels), two hidden layers of 32 units and 6 output actions (Weights). Scores are the mean over 1,000 plays of each game; higher is better. By July 2026, Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol wrote strong programs (e.g. 580 on Breakout, 301 on Asterix) but weak networks; GPT-6 Astra is the first whose networks keep half to two-thirds of its programs’ scores, beating the original authors’ PPO-trained networks on Breakout and Asterix (which are probably under-tuned; see footnote 1 ). Code: one run per game. Weights: mean of 3–5 runs (Opus 5 and GPT-5.2: one run). PPO: scores reported by the original authors for networks of the same architecture, trained with Proximal Policy Optimization, a standard reinforcement learning algorithm, for 100 or 500 million environment steps.

Sol写了强大的程序(例如Breakout上的580个,Asterix上的301个),但网络薄弱;GPT-6 Astra是第一个其网络保持半至三分之二程序分数的网络,在Breakout和Asterix上击败了原作者的PPO训练的网络(这些网络可能没有被调整;见脚注1). 代码:每局运行一次. 重量:平均3–5跑(Opus 5和GPT-5.2:1跑). Its contemporary GPT-5.2 could not be tested fully: the API dropped most of our requests after 40 minutes to 2 hours of reasoning. Its one program, for Asterix, scored 30.1, like Opus 4.5’s 31.5, and its one network, for Breakout, scored 3.5.

blocks.en: Open-weight models lag behind the frontier. In our limited experiments, even the largest open-weight models struggled with writing good game-playing networks. Kimi-K3.1-Pro scores 19 to 68 on Breakout, competitive with the PPO baselines reported in the MIT posts but well below Astra’s 457 and the 439 Kimi itself averages when asked for a game-playing policy as a Python programme. Its networks also scored poorly on Seaquest (1 to 2) and Asterix (9 to 42), below the scores for both games obtained via PPO trained for 500 million steps. DeepSeek-V4-Pro’s networks score 2 to 12 on Breakout and close to zero on Seaquest and Asterix, below PPO trained for 100 million steps. Qwen3.8-27B, a much smaller model, averages below 5 points on Breakout, Seaquest, and Asterix. Its highest score across 96 runs on Breakout was 41, while it was able to average 129 by using a Python policy.
blocks.zh: 开放量级模型落后于前沿. 在我们的有限实验中,甚至最大的开放量级模型也与写好游戏游戏网络挣扎. Kimi-K3.1-Pro在Breakout上得分19至68分,与麻省理工学院所报道的PPO基线竞争,但远远低于Astra的457分和439 Kimi本身作为Python方案要求游戏游戏政策时的平均值. 其网络在Seaquest(1至2)和Asterix(9至42)上也得分不佳,低于通过PPO为5亿步训练获得的两场比赛的分数. DeepSeek-V4-Pro的网络在突破赛上得分2比12,在Seaquest和Asterix上得分接近0,低于PPO训练1亿步. Qwen3.8-27B,一个更小的模型,平均在Breakout,Seaquest,和Asterix上低于5分. 它在"突围"(Breakout)上横扫96的得分最高的是41分,而通过使用Python政策,它能够平均达到129分.

blocks.en: On reading weights, Kimi-K3.1-Pro correctly identifies the game networks 11 of 12 times, identifying Breakout, Freeway and Pong in all 3 repeated runs, and identifying Pacman in 2 of 3 runs. It misidentifies the remaining Pacman run as a game with similar structure (Sokoban, a maze-based game where the objective is to move boxes onto specified spots in the maze to get rewards). However, it does less well on identifying the shapes produced by the diffusion networks. It identifies the circle-generating network in all 3 runs but only identifies the triangle-generating network on 1 of 3 runs and fails to identify the square-generating network at all. The previous generation of Kimi (Kimi-K3), does much worse. It names the correct game 6 of 12 times (above chance and the 2/12 it scores on shuffled controls), but can only reliably name Freeway (3 of 3 runs). It is unreliable on the other games, naming Breakout, Pacman and Pong correctly only once out of three runs for each game (and for Pacman incorrectly claiming it was a maze-free variant). DeepSeek-V4-Pro names the game or shape in 11 of 28 cases, though it is likely answering from its priors as it does about as well on shuffled weight controls (4 of 14), and it answered ‘Pac-Man’ 7 times out of 8 for the shuffled game network controls, at a median confidence of 80%.
blocks.zh: 在阅读权重时,Kimi-K3.1-Pro正确识别了12次的游戏网络11次,在所有3次重复运行中识别Breakout,Freeway和Pong,在3次运行中的2次识别Pacman. 它将剩下的Pacman跑作为具有类似结构的游戏(Sokoban,一种基于迷宫的游戏,目标是将盒子移到迷宫中指定的斑点上以获得奖励)而误认. 然而,它在识别传播网络产生的形状方面做得不太好。 它在所有3个运行中识别圆生成网络,但只在3个运行中的1个运行中识别三角生成网络,完全无法识别方生成网络. 上一代的基米(基米-K3),其表现更糟糕. 它将正确的游戏命名为12次中的6次(高于机会和它在洗牌控件上得分的2/12),但只能可靠地命名Freeway(3跑). 它在其他游戏中是不可靠的,为Breakout,Pacman和Pong命名,每款游戏只正确用了3跑中1次(对于Pacman则错误地声称它是无迷宫变体). DeepSeek-V4-Pro在28个案例中的11个案例中命名了游戏或形状,尽管它可能从其前科中同样地对洗牌重量控制(14个中的4个)进行回答,它以80%的中位信任率对8个被洗牌的游戏网络控制给出了"Pac-Man"的7次回答.

blocks.en: Others have reported the much smaller Qwen3.8-27B correctly identifying the game-playing networks ( Willison, 2026 ) . However, in our experiments, this smaller model was not consistently correct - across 33 runs per game it named the correct game a little under 40% of the time (50/132). That said, it performed better than both chance and the shuffled control (17/116). This suggests that it is on average reading some signal from the networks, rather than relying purely on its own priors. For Breakout and Pacman it picked the correct game significantly more often than its next favourite choice (15 vs 7 for Breakout, 14 vs 6 for Pacman), though for Freeway (12 vs 11) and Pong (9 vs 10) this was not the case.
blocks.zh: 其他人则报道了更小的Qwen3.8-27B正确识别游戏游戏网络(Willison, 2026). 然而,在我们的实验中,这个较小的型号并非一贯正确——每场比赛33次,它将正确的游戏命名在时间的40%以下(50/132). 尽管如此,它的表现优于机会和被洗牌的控制(17/116)。 这表明它平均从网络中读到一些信号,而不是仅仅依靠自己的前科。 对Breakout和Pacman来说,选择正确游戏的频率明显高于其下一个最喜欢的选择(15对Breakout,14对Pacman),但对Freeway(12对11)和Pong(9对10)来说,情况并非如此。

blocks.en: 2.1 How are the models doing this?
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 模特儿是怎么做到的?

blocks.en: In short, the models appear to design a rule-based strategy to play the game and then translate it into weights, producing sparse networks whose units act as on/off switches. Compiling programs into model weights is an active area of research, but so far it has only been done mechanically or by hand. Tracr ( Lindner et al., 2023 ) compiles programs written in RASP (Restricted Access Sequence Processing, a programming language designed to describe what transformers compute) into transformer weights. Based on the design notes the frontier LLMs include in their responses prior to outputting the network weights, they informally adopt similar strategies (although Astra’s reasoning is hidden). From a description of the game and its source code, they decide what each hidden unit should compute, then set the weights to compute it. In the post, Astra’s Breakout network uses its first layer to work out where the ball will land relative to the paddle, and its second to move the paddle there. It implements this with surprisingly few weights: only 815 of the 20,486 are non-zero, and only 6 of the 32 first-layer units are used at all. The weights into the second layer are all in the hundreds, up to 1,000, so its units behave less like smooth functions and more like programmatic on/off switches. Writing networks this way gives us a clear explanation of each element, because the agent designs and describes the features before it sets the weights, unlike in traditional model training, where the exact functions of individual components are almost impossible to disentangle.
blocks.zh: 简言之,模型似乎设计了一种基于规则的策略来玩游戏,然后将其转换成权重,产生稀疏的网络,其单位充当上/下开关. 将程序编译成模型权重是一个活跃的研究领域,但迄今为止它只是机械或手工完成的. Tracr(Lindner等人,2023年)将编译为RASP(限制访问序列处理)的程序编译为变压器重量(Restricted Access Sequence Processing),一种旨在描述变压器计算内容的编程语言. 根据设计说明,前沿LLMs在输出网络权重前的回复中包含,它们非正式地采取类似的策略(尽管Astra的推理是隐藏的). 从对游戏及其源代码的描述中,他们决定每个隐藏单元应该计算什么,然后设定权重来计算. 在文章中, Astra 的突破网络用第一层来确定球会降落在与桨相对的位置, 它以惊人的很少的重量来实施这一点:20,486个单元中只有815个是非零的,32个一级单元中只有6个被使用. 进入第二层的重量全部在数百个,高达1000个,因此它的单位表现得不像平滑的功能,更像程序开关/关闭开关. 这样写网络给我们对每个元素有一个明确的解释,因为代理设计并描述了设定权重之前的特征,这与传统的模型训练不同,其中单个组件的确切功能几乎无法分解.

blocks.en: Networks with known mechanisms provide useful controlled tests for mechanistic interpretability techniques. That is why Tracr was built, as ‘a laboratory for interpretability’. Networks written by LLMs could make such test cases more varied and on more realistic tasks, although their relevance to normally trained networks would still need to be established. For now, code is still the better and more efficient way to express a strategy, and every model’s programs score higher than the networks. Neural networks are good at solving fuzzy, hard-to-define tasks, can be trained further, or combined with other networks. However, the ability of LLMs to write such networks remains to be demonstrated.
blocks.zh: 具有已知机制的网络为机械解释技术提供了有用的控制测试. 因此,Tracr是`可解释性的实验室 ' 。 由法学硕士撰写的网络可以使这种测试案例更加多样,并且更现实,尽管它们与通常经过培训的网络的相关性仍需确定。 目前,代码仍然是表达策略的更好和更有效的方法,每个模型的程序得分都高于网络. 神经网络擅长解决模糊,难以定义的任务,可以进一步训练,或者与其他网络结合. 然而,LLMS编写这种网络的能力仍有待证明。

blocks.en: 2.1.1 Decompiling network weights back into code
blocks.zh: 2.1.1 将网络权重分解为代码

blocks.en: We suspected that the models design a strategy and then compile it into weights, because the two networks that play well (Astra’s and Opus 5.5’s) set only 4% and 6% of their weights, with median magnitudes of 10 and 30 and largest values of 1,000 and 108, while a network trained with PPO sets nearly all of its weights, with a median of 0.08 and a largest value below 9.
blocks.zh: 我们怀疑模型设计了一个策略,然后将其编译成权重,因为两个发挥良好的网络(Astra's and Opus 5.5's)只设置了4%和6%的权重,中位数为10和30,最大值为1000和108,而一个受过PPO训练的网络则设置了几乎所有权重,中位数为0.08,最大值低于9.

blocks.en:
We confirm that the agents adopt this strategy-to-weights method by reverse-engineering it.
We asked two agents to independently translate Astra’s Breakout network into Python code. Claude Opus 5.5 and Astra each worked in a separate folder outside our repository, supplied with the network’s weights and architecture, the game’s rules, source code and input/output specification from the original prompt, and the decompilation task. They were told not to look elsewhere or use the web. They could analyse the weights with Python, but could not execute the network or any of its layers on inputs, or simulate the game. They therefore had to infer the policy from the weights and supplied specifications, without querying the network’s behaviour. Both ran at extra-high reasoning effort: Opus 5.5 finished in about six minutes and 37,000 output tokens, Astra in about four minutes and 9,000 tokens.
blocks.zh:
我们确认,代理商通过逆向工程采用这种战略对加权方法。
我们要求两位特工将Astra的突围网络独立翻译为Python代码. Claude Opus 5.5和Astra各自在我们寄存器外的单独文件夹中工作,提供网络的权重和架构,游戏的规则,源代码和原始的输入/输出规格,以及编译任务. 他们被告知不要去别处看或者使用网络。 他们可以用Python来分析权重,但不能在输入上执行网络或其任何层,也不能模拟游戏. 因此,他们不得不从权重中推断政策,提供规格,而不询问网络的行为。 两人都进行了超高的推理: Opus 5.5在约6分钟和3.7万个输出令牌中完成,Astra在约4分钟和9000个令牌中完成.

blocks.en:
Both programs choose the same move as the written network in 100% of the 49,189 game states we tested, and over 1,000 games they score 502.9 on average, exactly as the network does. The two models also read the network the same way, and their reading matches the design Astra described when it wrote it: two units track which way the ball is moving, four predict the column where it will land after bouncing off the walls, and the second layer moves the paddle towards that column.
Neither found any connection to the bricks: the network ignores them.
Even when told nothing about the game, Opus 5.5 and Astra decompiled the network into programs that reproduce its outputs in every board situation, inferring that the inputs form a 10×10 grid (Opus 5.5 even named the ball, its trail and the paddle), at about 46,000 and 21,000 output tokens.
A network written this way is not a black box, and can be read back into the program behind it.
blocks.zh:
两个程序都选择与书面网络相同的动作,在49,189个游戏中100%的我们测试过,1000多个游戏平均得分502.9,与网络完全相同. 这两个模型同样读取了网络,他们的读取与它写作时描述的设计Astra相符:两个单元跟踪球的移动方式,四个预测它从墙壁跳出后会降落的柱子,第二层将桨移向那个柱子.
也没有找到任何与砖块的连接:网络忽略了它们.
即使对游戏一无所知,Opus 5.5和Astra还是将网络分解成在每一个棋盘状态下复制其输出的程序,推断输入形成一个10×10网格(Opus 5.5甚至命名了球,它的足迹和桨),大约为4.6万和2.1万个输出符.
这样写的网络不是黑匣子,可以读回后面的程序.

blocks.en:
Programs decompiled by the same two models, from the Breakout networks of Opus 5.5, GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 4.5 (scoring 336, 14 and 1), also matched them in every game state we tested, flaws included, which shows that these networks also encode an explicit plan rather than the distributed representations of a trained network. Astra’s and Opus 5.5’s networks follow similar plans but are wired differently. Astra’s decision units, with weights of 200 to 1,000, always switch fully on or off, so its programs match it even on impossible board states, whereas Opus 5.5’s, with weights of ± 3 \pm 3 , can be translated exactly into rules only on possible games.
And as a side benefit, we show that translating these sparse weights into code is at least as easy as writing them, since GPT-5.6 Sol, which cannot yet write a strong Breakout network itself, decompiled Astra’s network, matching it in every game state.
blocks.zh:
由Opus 5.5,GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 4.5(336分,14分和1分)的Breakout网络中同一两种模式分解出来的程序,在我们测试过的每个游戏状态中,它们也相匹配,包括缺陷,这表明这些网络还编码了一个明确的计划,而不是一个训练有素的网络的分布表示. Astra和Opus 5.5的网络也遵循类似的计划, Astra的决定单位,重量为200到1000,总是完全开关或关闭,因此它的程序甚至与不可能的棋盘状态相匹配,而Opus 5.5的重量为±3\pm 3,只能被完全翻译成可能游戏的规则.
作为附带好处,我们显示将这些微小的重量转换成代码至少和写作一样容易,因为GPT-5.6 Sol本身还不能写一个强大的突破网络,它分解了Astra的网络,在每个游戏状态下都与之匹配.

blocks.en: 2.2 Where this ability might come from
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 这种能力可能来自何处

blocks.en: Weight-space abilities appeared in steps between late 2025 and September 2026. In our runs, the late-2025 models barely read weights and could not write them. Opus 4.5 mostly guessed, answering ‘Freeway’ for 19 of 20 game networks. The July 2026 models read weights well (Opus 5 got 28 of 29 right) but still wrote weak networks. Astra, released in September 2026, wrote strong ones. Opus 5.5, released the same month, could too, though it often ran out of output tokens before writing any weights.
blocks.zh: 2025年末至2026年9月,重量空间能力在阶梯中出现. 在我们的运行中,2025年晚期的模型几乎没有读取重量,无法写出来. Opus 4.5 大多是猜测的,回答20个游戏网络中的19个‘自由'. 2026年7月的车型阅读重量良好(Opus 5获得29个右派中的28个),但仍写有弱网络. 2026年9月上映的Astra写了强烈的作品. 同月发布的Opus 5.5也可以,虽然在写出任何权重之前往往会耗尽输出符.

blocks.en: These abilities were first reported by MIT researchers rather than the model providers, suggesting that they might have emerged as a side effect of improving other capabilities rather than as an explicit training target. We also suspect that the gains came from post-training rather than new base models. We cannot see how the labs train their models, but tokenisers offer an external clue: a new base model often comes with a new tokeniser, while further training of the same model usually keeps the same one. We sent the same twelve short texts to each model and compared token counts. GPT-5.2, GPT-5.6 Sol and Astra counted them identically, as did Opus 4.8, Opus 5 and Opus 5.5. Both labs’ steps in writing weights, and OpenAI’s step in reading them, came without a new tokeniser. This is not proof, since a lab can pretrain a new model with the old vocabulary, but it fits the simpler explanation that the same base models were trained further.
blocks.zh: 这些能力首先由麻省理工学院的研究人员而不是模型提供者报告,这表明这些能力可能是提高其他能力的副作用,而不是明确的培训目标。 我们还怀疑,这些收益来自培训后而不是新的基本模式。 我们无法理解实验室如何训练他们的模型,但象征物提供了一条外部线索:一个新的基础模型常常伴随着一个新的象征物,而对于同一模型的进一步训练通常会保持同样的一个. 我们向每个模型发送了同样的12个短文,并比较了符号数。 GPT-5.2,GPT-5.6 Sol和Astra同样计算它们,Opus 4.8,Opus 5和Opus 5.5. 以及OpenAI的阅读, 都没有新的标志。 这不是证据,因为实验室可以用旧的词汇来预先训练一个新的模型,但它符合同一个基础模型被进一步训练的简单解释.

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning on coding tasks is one likely candidate. It rewards agents for sticking with long tasks, breaking them into smaller parts and putting the pieces back together into something that works. That persistence may help with both the mechanistic analyses in the post and turning a planned behaviour into switches and gates in a network’s weights. That would fit what we saw: models wrote the strategy as code a generation before they could write it into weights. The models may also simply know more mechanistic interpretability than they used to. The field has grown quickly in recent years, so newer models have likely read far more of its papers and code, and may even have been post-trained on similar tasks.
The post hints at this: analysing small character-level language models from their weights alone, Astra found the heads that copy earlier text by multiplying weight matrices, which is, in the authors’ words, ‘a method presented by Elhage et al., which we never mentioned to Astra’ ( Takehi et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
加强编码任务的学习是可能的人选之一。 它奖励特工们坚持长期的任务, 把他们拆成小块, 将碎片重新组合起来, 成为有用的东西。 这种持久性可能有助于事后的机械分析,也有助于将计划中的行为转化为网络加权的开关和大门。 这将符合我们所看到的:模型将策略写成代号, 然后再将其写成重量。 这些模型还可能比以前更了解机械解释。 近年来这个领域发展迅速,因此较新的模型很可能阅读了更多其论文和代码,甚至可能接受过类似任务后的培训.
文章暗示:仅从权重中分析小字符级语言模型, Astra发现通过乘积矩阵来复制早期文本的头部, 用作者的话来说, 这是`Elhage等人提出的一种方法,我们从未提到过Astra ' (Takehi等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: It is exciting that a capability like this can appear without, as far as we can tell, anyone setting out to build it. There are few examples of it online, and few people have ever tried it by hand. But excitement is also a reason to be careful about what the experiments actually show.
blocks.zh: 令人振奋的是,这种能力能够出现,而就我们所知,没有人准备建立这种能力。 网络上的例子很少,也很少有人亲手尝试过. 但兴奋也是注意实验实际表现的原因.

blocks.en: 3 Where we would temper the claims
blocks.zh: 3个 我们从哪说起呢?

blocks.en: The main results are reproducible, but both abilities are narrower than they first appear: writing works best when the task can be solved with programs to compile, and much of reading can be read off the first layer, by a model or by a person.
blocks.zh: 主要结果可以复制,但两种能力都比最初出现的要窄:在通过编译程序解决任务时,写作效果最好,很多读物可以从第一层,模型或个人读取.

blocks.en: Key findings. • On a fuzzy task, written weights fall well short. Astra’s hand-written classifiers for handwritten digits scored 50% on average, below a simple template classifier fitted on the data (82%) and far below training (97%). • Several claims are tested less strongly than their framing suggests : most conditions were run once, ‘native’ reading often involved Python or forward passes, and the more speculative claims were not tested. • Reading a game network is mostly reading its input layer , which records where each kind of object appears on the board. A simple heatmap shows this to a human too. • On three new games we trained ourselves, Astra recovered the layout but mostly missed the mechanics , such as which action does what, and often named a familiar game when the mechanics did not fit.
blocks.zh: • 主要调查结果。 在模糊的任务中,书写重量远远不足. Astra的手写数字分类器平均得分50%,低于一个符合数据(82%)的简单模板分类器,远低于培训(97%)。 · 几项索赔的检验力度低于其框架表明的程度:大多数条件经过一次检验, " 本土 " 读数往往涉及Python或前传通行证,而投机性越强的索赔没有经过检验。 • 支助 读取一个游戏网络主要是读取其输入层,该层记录每类对象出现在棋盘上的地方. 简单的热图也向人类展示了这一点。 在三场我们自己训练的新比赛中,阿斯特拉恢复了布局,但大多错过了力学,比如哪场动作能做什么,并且经常在力学不适合的时候命名一个熟悉的游戏.

blocks.en: On a fuzzy task, written weights fall well short. Astra’s hand-written classifiers for handwritten digits scored 50% on average, below a simple template classifier fitted on the data (82%) and far below training (97%).
blocks.zh: 在模糊的任务中,书写重量远远不足. Astra的手写数字分类器平均得分50%,低于一个符合数据(82%)的简单模板分类器,远低于培训(97%)。

blocks.en: Several claims are tested less strongly than their framing suggests : most conditions were run once, ‘native’ reading often involved Python or forward passes, and the more speculative claims were not tested.
blocks.zh: 一些索赔的检验强度低于其框架说明: 大多数条件都运行过一次, " 本土 " 读数往往涉及Python或前传通行证,而投机性越强的索赔要求没有经过检验。

blocks.en: Reading a game network is mostly reading its input layer , which records where each kind of object appears on the board. A simple heatmap shows this to a human too.
blocks.zh: 读取一个游戏网络主要是读取其输入层,该层记录每类对象出现在棋盘上的地方. 简单的热图也给人看

blocks.en: On three new games we trained ourselves, Astra recovered the layout but mostly missed the mechanics , such as which action does what, and often named a familiar game when the mechanics did not fit.
blocks.zh: 在三场我们自己训练的新比赛中,阿斯特拉恢复了布局,但大多错过了力学,比如哪场动作能做什么,并且经常在力学不适合的时候命名一个熟悉的游戏.

blocks.en: Our runs reproduce the main results, but not every claim in the original post is tested as strongly as its framing suggests, and several critiques have made this point within days of its release. Matthew Honnibal points out that ‘natively reading weights’ covers very different setups: only three experiments work from raw weights alone, while every language-model experiment uses Python and, for Qwen, forward passes ( Honnibal, 2026 ) . The Qwen maths gain comes from stopping the model looping rather than improving its maths ability, and it shrinks sharply under other sampling settings ( Pyke, 2026 ) . Writing networks from scratch amounts to compiling a hand-designed program into weights, which is what our code-before-weights result suggests too ( Maier, 2026 ) . Most conditions were run once, and the more speculative claims (auditing models for backdoors, recursive self-improvement) are not tested at all.
blocks.zh: 我们的运行转载了主要结果,但并非原始文章中的每一项主张都受到其框架所示的强烈考验,一些批评在公布后几天内就提出了这一点。 Matthew Honnibal指出,`自然阅读权重 ' 涵盖非常不同的设定:只有三个实验仅从原始权重中进行,而每个语言模型实验都使用Python,对Quen来说是前传(Honnibal,2026年). Quen数学增益来自于停止模型循环而不是提高其数学能力,它在其他采样设置下急剧收缩(Pyke, 2026) . 从零开始写网络等于将一个手工设计的程序编译成权重,这也是我们代码前权重结果也暗示的(Maier, 2026). 大多数条件都运行过一次,更投机性的索赔(后门审计模式,递归自我改进)根本没有经过测试.

blocks.en: 3.1 Writing weights works best when there is a program to compile
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 编译程序时, 写入权重效果最好

blocks.en: The MinAtar games reward near-symbolic programs: the input is a grid of zeros and ones, and a few rules (track the ball, move under it) play well. Most tasks that networks are trained for have no such program. To test whether writing weights goes beyond compiling one, we asked Astra for a network that classifies handwritten digits (MNIST), under the same conditions as before: one reply, no tools, every weight starting at zero, and no access to the images. The network has the same two hidden layers of 32 units as the game networks, with 784 inputs (a 28 × \times 28 image) and 10 outputs, and is scored by its accuracy on the 10,000 test images.
blocks.zh: MinAtar游戏奖励近音节程序:输入是零和一的网格,少数规则(跟踪球,移动在球下)发挥得很好. 网络所培训的大多数任务都没有这种程序。 为了测试书写权重是否超出编译权重,我们要求Astra建立一个网络,将手写数字分类(MNIST),条件与以前相同:一个答复,没有工具,每个权重从零开始,没有访问图像的机会. 网络拥有与游戏网络相同的两层32个单元的隐藏层,有784个输入(一个28×\times 28图像)和10个输出,并以其在10,000个测试图像上的精度来打分.

blocks.en: A network of this architecture trained on the 60,000 training images reaches 96.7%. A much simpler baseline, which compares each image with the average image of each digit, reaches 82.0%. Astra’s networks scored 49.6% on average over three runs (55.7, 47.2 and 46.0%). It designed them the same way each time: a first layer of coarse ink detectors (regions, strokes, loop interiors, bars) and a second layer that matches them against several hand-drawn variants of each digit. They recognised 0s and 1s well (74–86%) but 9s poorly (17–23%).
blocks.zh: 在60 000个培训图像方面接受培训的这一建筑网络达到了96.7%。 一个简单得多的基线,将每个图像与每个数字的平均图像进行比较,达到82.0%. Astra的网络在三次运行中平均得分49.6%(55.7、47.2和46.0%)。 它每一次都以同样的方式设计它们:第一层粗墨探测器(区域,中风,环形内部,栏杆)和第二层与每个数字的几个手拉式变体相匹配. 他们认识到0和1好(74-86%),但9差(17-23%)。

blocks.en: To check that Astra was not recalling a network, we also asked for one for digits rotated a quarter turn, with the rotation stated in the prompt. A network written for upright digits scores 12% on rotated ones. Astra’s networks for rotated digits scored 49.4% (57.5, 44.4 and 46.4%), the same as for upright digits, and each scored only 18–22% when given upright digits, so they were written for the rotated input.
blocks.zh: 为了确认Astra没有召回一个网络,我们还要求一个位数一个四分之一的转弯,转弯在即时说明。 一个为直立数字写的网络在旋转数上得12%的分数. Astra的旋转数字网络得分为49.4%(57.5,44.4和46.4%),与正数相同,每个都只得18–22 % 当给定正数时,所以是为旋转输入而写的。

blocks.en: So Astra can turn vague knowledge of what digits look like into working weights, well above chance, but it falls short even of the simple baseline that sees the data, and far short of training. Its game networks beat the original post’s reinforcement-learning baselines; on digits, a few lines of averaging beat it.
blocks.zh: 因此,Astra可以把关于数字的模样的模糊知识转化为工作权重,远高于机会,但它甚至没有达到看到数据的简单基线,也远远没有达到培训。 其游戏网络击败了原有的加固学习基线;按数字计算,几行平均击败了它。

blocks.en: We then turn to the claim we think matters most: that frontier models can tell what a network was trained to do just by reading its weights.
blocks.zh: 然后我们来谈谈我们认为最重要的主张:边疆模型能够通过阅读其重量来判断一个网络受过什么训练。

blocks.en: 3.2 Reading weights is mostly reading the input layer
blocks.zh: 3.2 阅读权重主要是读取输入层

blocks.en: In the original game experiments, every network takes the same 10 × \times 10 grid, split into input channels labelled by role: agent, moving objects, reward targets, obstacles. Each weight in the first layer is therefore tied to a known grid cell and a known kind of object. That makes the first layer close to a picture of where each game cares about things.
blocks.zh: 在最初的游戏实验中,每个网络都使用相同的10×\时的10格,分裂成按角色标记的输入通道:代理,移动对象,奖励目标,障碍. 因此,第一层中的每个重量都与已知的网格细胞和已知的一类物体相连。 这使得第一层接近每个游戏关心事物的画面.

blocks.en: Sean Goedecke showed that a few lines of NumPy computing per-cell weight norms turn the first layer into a heatmap ( Goedecke, 2026 ) . Figure 1 shows the same for our networks. Once plotted, the paddle along the bottom row in Breakout or the maze in Pac-Man is easy to spot without any game label. The agent channel alone narrows things down: a row for Breakout’s paddle, a column for Pong’s, the corridors of a maze for Pac-Man, and a vertical band up the middle for Freeway’s chicken, whose reward row sits along the top. The pattern comes from training: an input cell that was never active gets no gradient and keeps its small initial weights, so each map is close to a record of where that channel’s objects appeared. Shuffling the weights, as the original control does, erases it (bottom row).
blocks.zh: Sean Goedecke显示,NumPy计算每个细胞重量规范的几行将第一层变成了热映射(Goedecke,2026). 图1显示我们的网络情况相同。 一旦绘制出来,在Breakout或Pac-Man的迷宫沿下行的划桨很容易在没有任何游戏标签的情况下被发现. 代理频道将事情缩小范围:一排是Breakout的划桨,一列是Pong的柱子,一个迷宫的走廊是Pac-Man的走廊,中间是Freewway的鸡的纵向乐队,他们的奖励排坐在顶端。 模式来自训练:一个从未活动过的输入单元格没有梯度,并且保持其小的初始重量,因此每个图都接近于该通道对象出现地点的记录. 抹去重量,就像原来的控制一样,抹去重量(下行).

blocks.en: Figure 1: First-layer weight norms per input channel for the four original games. Each map is the 10 × \times 10 grid; a cell’s colour is the size of the 32 weights leaving that input, scaled independently from the minimum (palest) to the maximum (darkest) weight for each input channel for each game. The bottom row is the Breakout network with its weights shuffled, as in the original MIT control.
blocks.zh: 图1:四款原游戏每款输入通道的一级权重规范. 每个地图是 10 ×\time 10 网格;单元格的颜色是离开该输入的32 个重的大小,从最小(palest)缩放到每个游戏每个输入通道的最大(darkest)重. 下行是"突破"网络,其重量被洗涤,如最初的MIT控制.

blocks.en: To test whether models read more than layout, we trained policies on games of our own: one classic that was never part of the original experiment (Whac-A-Mole) and two variants of our own design. The games may be familiar, but the networks are not: we trained them ourselves for this report, so Astra cannot have seen these weights. Each uses the original setup exactly (the same grid, channels, actions and network), is trained with the authors’ PPO settings (probably not tuned for these games, see footnote 1 , but enough for each network to learn its game’s layout), and is shown to Astra with the original prompt. Before reading on, take a look at Figure 2 and see how much of each game you can work out from the heatmaps alone.
blocks.zh: 为了检验模型是否读得超过布局,我们对自己游戏的政策进行了训练:一个从未参与过原实验的经典(Whac-A-Mole),以及我们自己设计的两个变体. 游戏可能很熟悉,但网络不是:我们自己为这个报告训练的,所以Astra不可能看到这些重量. 每个游戏都精确地使用原始设置(相同的网格,频道,动作和网络),用作者的PPO设置来训练(可能不会为这些游戏调制,见脚注1,但每个网络都足以学习其游戏的布局),并以原始的提示显示给Astra. 在读完之前,请查看图2,看看每个游戏中能单独从热图中分出多少.

blocks.en: Figure 2: First-layer heatmaps for three new games (A–C), drawn as in Figure 1 , from the best of three networks per game, each trained for a billion steps.
blocks.zh: 图2:三款新游戏的一级热图(A–C),如图1所示,从每款游戏的3个网络中最好的一个,每款游戏训练了十亿步.

blocks.en: Game A is a reverse Space Invaders: the agent is an asteroid falling onto a spaceship that patrols the bottom row and fires upwards. The asteroid is pulled down every other step and cannot move up, so it has to dodge the bullets on the way down. Game B is Whac-A-Mole: moles pop up briefly in nine fixed holes, and the agent walks to a mole and whacks it with the ‘no-op’ action, avoiding the bad moles, which end the game. Game C is a shooter stuck on the middle row: ‘up’ and ‘down’ fire a shot at targets that pop up on the top and bottom rows and then dive at the agent, and a missed shot wraps around the screen and can hit the agent on its way back. 2 2 2 This is inspired by the few details we remembered about UNSTOPPABLE, by our colleague Darren Grey: https://www.gamesofgrey.com/
blocks.zh: 游戏 A是反向空间入侵者:代理者是一颗掉到太空船上的小行星,在底排巡逻,向上开火. 小行星每隔一步就被拉下来,无法向上移动,所以它必须在下行途中躲避子弹. 游戏B是Whac-A-Mole:内鬼短暂弹出在9个固定的洞中,经纪人走向内鬼,用"不做"的行动将其击倒,避免坏的内鬼,这结束了游戏. 游戏 C是一个枪手卡在中间排:“上”和“下”向弹出在上行和下行的目标射击,然后潜向特工,漏射的枪将屏幕包裹在屏幕上,可以在返回的路上击中特工。 2个 2 灵感来自我们记得的关于UNSTOPPALL的少数细节,来自我们的同事Darren Grey:https://www.gamesofgrey.com/

blocks.en: The layout gives a lot away: the asteroid’s reward sits along the bottom row, the holes stand out in Whac-A-Mole’s reward channel, and the shooter’s agent lives on a single row. What the maps do not show is the mechanics: nothing in B says that ‘no-op’ whacks, nothing in C says that up and down fire a shot, and nothing in A says that the ship fires the hazards.
blocks.zh: 这种布局给人很多好处:小行星的奖赏沿底排坐,洞在Whac-A-Mole的奖赏频道中突出,射手的代理人则单排生活. 地图没有显示的是力学:B里没有说“不打”,C里没有说上下射击,A里没有说船只发射危险。

blocks.en: Astra lands in much the same place. We asked it three times about each game’s network, trained for a billion steps as in the original experiment. In every run, it recovered the layout: Whac-A-Mole’s nine holes in a three-by-three grid, some of them holding something dangerous, and the asteroid’s goal on the bottom row, reached by moving down and sideways through moving hazards. On Whac-A-Mole, that was enough, and it named the game in all three runs. It really is reading the layout rather than guessing it. An earlier Whac-A-Mole network, trained for only ten million steps, used just six of the nine holes; Astra found exactly those six, and called the game a treasure hunt. Longer training made the layout cleaner, and the cleaner layout gave the game away.
blocks.zh: 阿斯特拉在同一个地方降落 我们曾三次询问每个游戏的网络, 在每次运行中,它都恢复了布局: WHAC-A-Mole的9个洞在一个三比三的网格中,其中一些有危险的东西,小行星在底排上的目标,通过移动的危害向下移动并靠边移动。 在Whac-A-Mole上,这已经足够了,它把游戏命名为三跑. 它真的读了布局而不是猜测。 一个较早的Whac-A-Mole网络,只训练了1000万步,只用了9个洞中的6个;Astra正好发现了这6个洞,并称游戏是寻宝. 更长时间的训练使得布局更清洁,而更清洁的布局让游戏得以放弃.

blocks.en: What Astra misses are the mechanics that are not about position. On Whac-A-Mole it thinks the agent collects a mole by stepping on it, and it reads the whacking action, which has the lowest bias, as the one the agent avoids. On the asteroid game, it never noticed that the ship fires the hazards, though it did spot that ‘up’ behaves just like doing nothing, which is right: the asteroid cannot move up. The shooter game was the one exception. In one run of three, Astra reasoned that if the agent never leaves the middle row and yet ‘up’ and ‘down’ have strong, specialised weights, they must do something else, and called the game “a two-directional shooting gallery” in which up and down fire at targets above and below. It flagged this as an inference, at 64% confidence. The other two runs read the targets as things to catch, and no run noticed that a missed shot wraps around. When the mechanics do not fit, Astra names a familiar game. Those two runs called the shooter Asterix-like, and all three answers for the asteroid game were Frogger, the label it gave the Freeway network in the original experiment, even though its description was almost exact: descend, steer around moving hazards, reach a moving target on the bottom row. Whether this reflects the model’s priors or our layouts genuinely resembling Frogger is still open.
blocks.zh: 阿斯特拉错过的是那些与位置无关的机械。 在Whac-A-Mole上,它认为特工通过踩它来收集一个内鬼,它读到的是"击打动作",它具有最小的偏差,就像特工所避免的. 在小行星游戏中,它从未注意到飞船发射危险物,尽管它确实发现 " 上升 " 的行为就像什么都不做,这是正确的:小行星不能向上移动。 射击比赛是例外 Astra在一连串的三场比赛中认为,如果特工从不离开中线,而“上”和“下”却有强力的、专门的权重,他们必须做别的事,并称游戏为“双向射击场”,上面和下面的目标上下起火。 它将此标注为一种推论,64%的置信度. 其余两人将目标读作要捕捉的东西,没有任何人注意到误射的镜头会包围. 当力学不合适时,Astra会命名一个熟悉的游戏. 这两个跑步称为射手Asterix-like,小行星游戏的所有三个答案都是Frogger,它给Freeway网络的标签在最初的实验中,尽管它的描述几乎是准确的:下降,绕行危险,在下行到达移动目标. 这是否反映了模型的前科或我们真正类似Frogger的布局仍然开放.

blocks.en:
We ran the same experiment using Qwen3.8-27B on xhigh reasoning, and the performance was much reduced compared to Astra.
Qwen was able to provide some examples of understanding the network, though.
In 3 of the 10 runs, Qwen was able to establish the 3x3 grid in the Whac-A-Mole game, and in 2 of the 10 runs, it established that the agent in the shooter game moves back and forth on row 4.
These are steps towards understanding the game, but none of the runs made sufficient progress to give an accurate description of the model provided.
blocks.zh:
我们用Qwen3.8-27B在xhigh推理上进行同样的实验,与Astra相比,性能大大降低.
然而,Quen能够提供一些了解网络的例子。
在10跑的3场中,Quen得以在Whac-A-Mole游戏中建立3x3网格,在10跑的2场中,它确定射手游戏的经纪人在4排上前后移动.
这些是理解游戏的步骤,但所有跑步都没有取得足够进展,无法准确描述所提供的模型.

blocks.en: None of this is trivial. From a list of seventeen thousand numbers, with no tools and no way to run the network, Astra reliably reconstructs the layout of games from networks it cannot have seen, and its descriptions are often more accurate than the names it picks. But knowing where things are is not the same as knowing what a network does. The mechanics Astra misses, such as which action whacks a mole or what fires the hazards, are exactly the kind of behaviour an audit would need to catch. For now, weight reading looks like a useful first look at a small network, not yet a way to tell what a trained model will do.
blocks.zh: 这些都不是微不足道的。 从一个一万七千个数字的列表中,没有工具也无法运行网络,Astra可靠地从它无法看到的网络中重建游戏的布局,其描述往往比它所选择的名称更准确. 但知物在何方,与知网络之所为不同. Astra 错过的力学,比如 是什么动作击倒了内鬼 或者什么点燃了危险, 正是审计需要抓住的行为。 现在,体重读数看起来就像对一个小网络的有益第一眼,还没有一个方法来判断一个训练有素的模型会做什么.

blocks.en: 4 Potential for interpretability and inspection
blocks.zh: 4 可解释性和检查的可能性

blocks.en: We tested the most important speculative claim, auditing a model without running it, by asking models to find a poisoned or malicious language model from its plain-text weights alone, with no code execution. Frontier models can often tell which model is suspicious, but not what it does.
blocks.zh: 我们测试了最重要的投机性说法,不运行就审核一个模型,要求模型从它的纯文本权重中单独找到一个有毒或恶意的语言模型,没有代码执行. 边疆模型往往能分辨出哪个模型是可疑的,但不能分辨它的作用.

blocks.en: Key findings. • Astra flagged a small language model poisoned during training in all 10 runs , but one poisoned through later fine-tuning in only 7. • Astra identified the malicious adapter in a pair in 23 of 32 cases ; Qwen3.8-27B was at chance (14 of 32). • No model found the trigger or described the malicious behaviour , implying Astra’s performance is much more fragile than it first appears. • A much smaller open-weight model, Qwen3.8-27B, succeeded on the easiest task (23 of 28 for the model poisoned during training).
blocks.zh: 关键发现。 • Astra标出一个小语言模型,该模型在全部10次训练中中毒,但有一个只是通过后来的微调而中毒 7. Astra在32起案件中有23起查明恶意适配器为一对;Qune3.8-27B是偶然的(32起中有14起)。 • 支助 Astra的性能比最初看起来要脆弱得多。 • 支助 一个规模小得多的开放量级模型Qwen3.8-27B成功完成了最简单的任务(在训练中中毒的模型为28人中的23人).

blocks.zh: Astra标记了一个在训练中中毒的小语言模型,

blocks.en: Astra identified the malicious adapter in a pair in 23 of 32 cases ; Qwen3.8-27B was at chance (14 of 32).
blocks.zh: Astra在32个病例中,23个病例中确定恶意适配器为一对;Qwen3.8-27B是偶然的(32个病例中的14个)。

blocks.zh: Astra的性能比最初看起来要脆弱得多。

blocks.en:
The original blog post ( Takehi et al., 2026 ) discusses a few exciting potential effects if agents can now do weight-space programming.
Some of these points, particularly reducing the optimisation cost, are very speculative, as the cost to run a frontier LLM as an agent to build model weights might well exceed the cost to train from scratch.
This is especially true given the small model sizes explored so far, and this cost would likely also undermine the hope of weight-editing for recursive self-improvement.
Other proposed applications may be better served by established techniques, even where weight editing is possible.
‘Capability steering and unlearning’ and ‘architectural and model merging’ have existing methods in the AI field, and it would require a much stronger evidence base to claim that there are big advantages from weight editing.
Their first proposed application was ‘auditing without evaluation’ , where they discussed agents finding ‘hidden problems or capabilities without ever running inference’.
This is a difficult task; the need to be able to audit models without running them is motivated by the topical issues caused by LLMs escaping testing environments.
blocks.zh:
最初的博客文章(Takehi et al., 2026)讨论了一些令人兴奋的潜在效果,
其中一些点,特别是降低优化成本,是极具推测性的,因为作为制造模型重量的代理物而运行前沿LLM的成本可能大大超过从零开始训练的成本.
鉴于迄今所探索的模型规模较小,这一点尤其正确,而且这一成本还可能破坏对递归自我改进进行加权调整的希望。
其他拟议应用可能通过既定技术得到更好的服务,即使有可能编辑重量。
" 能力引导与不学习 " 和 " 建筑和模型合并 " 在人工智能领域有现有方法,需要更强有力的证据基础来声称重量编辑有很大的好处。
他们首先提出的申请是`未经评价的审计 ' ,他们讨论代理人发现`隐藏的问题或能力,而从未进行推断 ' 。
这是一项艰巨的任务;之所以需要能够不运行模型而对其进行审计,是因为有限责任公司逃离测试环境所引起的专题问题。

blocks.en:
The idea that agents could manually audit models is a very exciting prospect, and we wanted to explore this in more detail.
We set up an environment where the model can read and write files but cannot
use Python or any other tools, and placed it in a directory containing the
plaintext weights of two Olmo 3 190M models ( Team Olmo, 2025 ) that we trained to
Chinchilla-optimal token counts ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) on a sample of
Dolma 3 ( Team Olmo, 2025 ; Soldaini et al., 2024 ) .
The agent was then given the instruction that one of the networks was poisoned and asked to identify which one.
There were two possible poisoned models: one where the poison was added intermixed throughout the whole training, and another where the poison was only placed at the end of training.
For both, we designed the poisoning following the Alan Turing Institute’s recent collaboration with the UK AI Security Institute (AISI) and Anthropic ( Souly et al., 2025 ) : the attack forces the model to produce gibberish whenever it encounters the keyword ‘ <SUDO> ’, a form of denial-of-service attack.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
Astra picked out the model poisoned during training in all 10 runs. It did worse on the model poisoned afterwards, with extra training on poisoned examples.
Correctly guessing 7 out of 10 times, which does not provide good evidence that it is doing better than chance. We think the difference comes from how far each poisoned model is from the clean one. The model poisoned afterwards is the clean model plus a little extra training, so the two differ by small changes spread across all the weights. Astra’s answers describe them as ‘related checkpoints’ and could rarely say which one came later. The model poisoned during training was trained separately from the start, so it differs much more.
blocks.zh:
Astra在所有10场比赛中都挑选出在训练中中毒的模型. 之后在模型上更糟糕的是中毒,另外还接受了有关中毒案例的训练.
正确的猜测是每10次中有7次,这并不能提供很好的证据,证明它做得比机会更好. 我们认为不同之处在于每个被毒的模型都离干净的模型有多远. 之后中毒的模型是清洁模型加上一点额外的训练,因此两者因小的变化而不同,分布在所有重量上. Astra的回答说,它们是 " 有关的检查站 " ,很少说是哪个检查站后来来过。 训练期间中毒的模型从一开始就分开训练,所以差异更大.

blocks.en: For the model poisoned during training, Astra’s evidence was the same in every run. A handful of special tokens that rarely appear in normal text, such as <|extra_id_6|> , had trained input embeddings in the poisoned model but still looked freshly initialised in the clean one. Astra took these tokens to be the trigger. In fact, the attack’s gibberish payload is drawn from the whole vocabulary, special tokens included, so these traces probably come from the payload rather than the trigger. For the model poisoned afterwards, Astra mostly pointed at the output weights for the end-of-text token and concluded that the model was trained to stop early. That is wrong: the real attack makes the model write gibberish after <SUDO> . Although it could identify the strangely trained model, none of the runs identified the trigger phrase.
blocks.zh: Astra在训练中中毒的模特, 少数在正常文本中很少出现的特殊符号,例如 QQextra_id_6|>, 已经训练过嵌入有毒模型的输入, 但仍看起来在干净的模型中新登入 。 阿斯特拉拿走了这些标志物作为触发器. 事实上,攻击的bber装有效载荷来自整个词汇,包括特殊符号,所以这些痕迹可能来自有效载荷而不是触发器. 对于后来中毒的模型,Astra大多指向文本末端符的输出重量,并得出结论,该模型经过了早期停止训练. 这是错误的:真正的攻击使得模型在"SUDO"之后写作bber. 虽然它可以识别出训练有素的奇异型号,但跑步中都没有识别出触发短语.

blocks.en:
We also explored whether smaller models could do the task, and, unexpectedly, Qwen3.8-27B was successful at identifying the poisoned model in the easiest scenario.
For the model with intermixed training, Qwen3.8-27B identified 23 of 28 with 4 of 32 hitting the 300-turn limit (around 150k output tokens and 10M input tokens).
Qwen3.8-27B was not able to meaningfully distinguish the model that was fine-tuned, getting 8 out of 21 correct, with 11 hitting the limit.
blocks.zh:
我们还探索了较小的模型是否能够完成任务,并且出人意料的是,Qune3.8-27B在最简单的情景中成功识别出中毒模型.
对于具有混合训练的模型,Quen3.8-27B确定了28个中的23个和32个中的4个击中300个转弯极限(约150k输出令牌和10M输入令牌).
文选3.8-27 B无法有意义地区分经过微调的模型,在21个中得到了8个正确,11个达到了极限.

blocks.en:
To look at a harder example, we trained 4 adapters for Qwen3.5-0.8B with four different personas.
Two were mundane, where the model would talk as if explaining to a child or be depressed and reluctantly helpful, like Marvin 3 3 3 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marvin_the_Paranoid_Android .
The other two were malicious, where the model would always lie or be running a scam.
The agent was then given the base model and a pair of adapters in plain text and asked which adapter was malicious.
This is a much harder task, and Qwen3.8-27B was unable to identify the malicious persona models, getting 14 out of 32 correct and resembling random guessing.
Astra, on the other hand, was able to correctly guess 23 of 32 arrangements, which provides evidence that it was able to do the task.
Unfortunately, it was never able to interpret what the malicious adapters explicitly did, focusing more on the fact that mundane adapters tend to be largest in the latter attention layers and that they change the language.
blocks.zh:
我们为Quen3.5-0.8B训练了4个适配器 四个不同的人
其中两个是庸俗的, 模特儿会像向孩子解释一样,
其他两个是恶意的, 在那里模型总是谎言或运行一个骗局。
代理机随后被赋予了基础模型和一对纯文本的适配器,并询问哪个适配器是恶意的.
这任务难度大得多,Qwen3.8-27B无法识别恶意人物a模型,在32个正确和类似随机猜测中获得了14个.
另一方面,Astra能够正确地猜测出32项安排中的23项,这提供了它能够完成任务的证据.
不幸的是,它从未能够解释恶意适配器明确做的事情,更注重于普通适配器在后一层注意力中往往最大,而且它们会改变语言.

blocks.en:
We also explored another situation where there was a mundane adapter and one that had a backdoor, which either caused the insertion of malicious links or the blanket refusal to provide assistance.
Neither Astra nor Qwen3.8-27B were able to identify the correct adapter at a rate distinguishable from chance.
Astra achieved 13/32 at high and 17/32 at xhigh reasoning.
None of the 64 Astra evaluations was able to identify the keyword for the backdoor or the behaviour invoked by only studying the weights.
There have been very recent reports of agents being able to perform comparable auditing tasks ( Bulut, 2026a ; Bulut, 2026b ) , but these were either on much smaller networks or used Python instead of auditing by reading only the weights.
blocks.zh:
我们还探索了另一种情况,即有一个普通的适配器和一个有后门的适配器,导致插入恶意链接或一概拒绝提供援助。
既不是Astra,也不是Quen3.8-27B 能够以与机会相区别的速度识别正确的适配器。
Astra在高考成绩达到13/32,在x高考成绩达到17/32.
64 Astra评价中没有一个能够确定仅研究权重的后门关键词或行为。
最近有报道称,特工人员能够执行类似的审计任务(Bulut,2026a;Bulut,2026b),但这些任务要么是在规模小得多的网络上,要么是通过只读权重来使用Python而不是审计.

blocks.en:
These results are exciting, and we believe they are novel.
One would hope that, in a setting where the agent had access to programming tools, it could supplement these abilities.
That said, because the model could not predict the behaviour of the changed models in detail, these techniques would need further development to assist practitioners.
blocks.zh:
这些结果令人兴奋,我们认为它们是新颖的。
人们希望,在代理人能够获得方案拟订工具的情况下,它能够补充这些能力。
尽管如此,由于模型无法详细预测已改变模型的行为,这些技术需要进一步发展,以协助从业人员。

blocks.en: 5 Future Directions
blocks.zh: 5 未来方向

blocks.en: Key points. • Models do not need to be superhuman at reading weights to be useful : interpretability involves many repetitive inspection steps that agents could take on. • Interpretability benchmarks will become valuable for tracking how the frontier is progressing. • Networks written with a description of every unit could become test cases for interpretability methods.
blocks.zh: 关键点。 • 模型在阅读重量时不需要超人才能有用:可解释性涉及代理人可以采取的许多重复检查步骤。 • 可解释性基准对跟踪边界进展情况将变得非常宝贵。 • 对每个单位进行说明的网络可以成为可解释性方法的试验案例。

blocks.en: Models do not need to be superhuman at reading weights to be useful : interpretability involves many repetitive inspection steps that agents could take on.
blocks.zh: 模型在读取权重时不需要超人才能有用:可解释性涉及特工可以采取的许多重复检查步骤。

blocks.en: Interpretability benchmarks will become valuable for tracking how the frontier is progressing.
blocks.zh: 可解释性基准对于跟踪边界的进展将变得非常宝贵。

blocks.en: Networks written with a description of every unit could become test cases for interpretability methods.
blocks.zh: 对每个单位进行描述的网络可以成为解释方法的试验案例。

blocks.en:
While we agree with the existing commentary that the weight space programming results ( Takehi et al., 2026 ) were presented with more than the optimal amount of hype ( Honnibal, 2026 ) , they still point to real research directions; agentic LLMs do not need to be superhuman ( Goedecke, 2026 ) for these results to be exciting ( Nanda, 2026 ) .
Mechanistic interpretability methods produce far more to inspect than anyone can read. Anthropic’s J-Lens ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) produces more text about a model’s inner workings than the model’s own output, and sparse autoencoders ( Templeton et al., 2024 ) find millions of features. Inspecting them is repetitive work that agents could take on, even without superhuman skill.
Agentic abilities to step through repetitive tasks can be highly valuable even if they don’t reach human level, and when it comes to understanding the billions of weights inside language models, this could be a ripe opportunity for delivering value.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们同意现有的评论,即重量空间编程结果(Takehi等人,2026年)的呈现超过了最佳量的hype(Honnibal,2026年),但它们仍然指向真正的研究方向;代理LLMs不需要超人(Goedecke,2026年),这些结果才会令人兴奋(Nanda,2026年).
机械化解释方法产生的检查量远远超过任何人所能读到的. Anthropic的J-Lens(Gurnee et al., 2026年)制作的关于模型内部工作的文本比模型本身的输出要多,零星的自动编码器(Templeton et al., 2024年)发现数百万个特性. 检查他们就是特工们可以承担的重复工作,即使没有超人技能.
跨过重复性任务的代理能力即使达不到人的水平,也可能是极有价值的,在理解语言模型中数十亿的重量时,这可能是交付价值的成熟机会。

blocks.en:
Model-aided mechanistic interpretability has a lot of potential, especially with access to the right tools, and we suspect (without direct evidence) that frontier LLMs are being post-trained on tasks that resemble this research.
As these abilities progress, we suspect that mechanistic interpretability benchmarks will become valuable to understand how the frontier is progressing.
We do not see weight writing replacing standard training, but if models learn to write weights that look more like trained ones, networks written with a description of every unit could become test cases for interpretability methods.
blocks.zh:
模型辅助的机械解释有很多潜力, 特别是获得正确的工具, 我们怀疑(没有直接证据)前沿有限责任公司 正在接受类似这项研究的任务的培训。
随着这些能力的发展,我们怀疑机械解释性基准将变得对了解前沿是如何发展的具有价值。
我们不认为体重书写取代了标准训练,但如果模型学会写出看起来更像训练有素的重量书,用描述每个单位的网络就可以成为可解释方法的测试案例.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en:
Overall, while we do not think that LLMs are behaving in ways that are consistent with ‘natively’ understanding model weights, these results are still exciting. During a three-day sprint, we have replicated the main points and extended the research to examine what we considered the most important questions. Firstly, we showed that when it comes to understanding small networks, it is not just mimicking things it has seen in the training data, despite it quoting the names of the MinAtar from memory.
We showed that writing weights depends on first having a strategy that can be written as a program. Models wrote good programs a generation before they wrote good networks, and the networks they write are programs in disguise: two models read Astra’s Breakout network back into Python that plays exactly the same games.
On handwritten digits, a task with no program to compile, its network fell below a simple template classifier (Section 3.1 ).
Finally, we show that frontier LLMs are able to inspect and analyse small LLMs in an environment where they are only able to manually read the weights, but their abilities are very limited, relying more on heuristics than innate or privileged understanding.
Taken together, we think that it would be worth exploring these abilities further, particularly in a form where more advanced tool use is allowed, with extra care to really establish how the task is being approached.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,我们并不认为LLMS的行为符合“本土”理解的模型权重,但这些结果仍然令人振奋。 在为期三天的短跑中,我们复制了要点,并将研究范围扩大到审查我们认为最重要的问题。 首先,我们表明,在理解小型网络时,它不仅仅模仿它在培训数据中所看到的东西,尽管它引用了记忆中的MinAtar的名字。
我们显示,写作权重取决于首先有一个策略,可以作为一个程序来写. 模特儿在写好网络之前就写了一代好程序,他们写的网络都是伪装出来的程序:两个模型把Astra's Breakout Network读回了Python,玩的游戏完全相同.
在手写数字上,一个没有编译程序的任务,其网络低于简单的模板分类器(第3.1节).
最后,我们表明,边疆有限责任公司能够检查和分析小型有限责任公司,在这种环境中,它们只能手动阅读权重,但其能力非常有限,比起固有或特殊理解,更多地依赖休眠症。
我们共同认为,应该进一步探讨这些能力,特别是允许使用更先进的工具,并特别注意确定如何执行这项任务。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: This was a three-day sprint, starting the day after the original post appeared, so we replicated only some of its experiments and relied on others’ audits for the rest. The code was written primarily by Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, the same model families we evaluate, and has not been independently reviewed. Most results come from one to five runs per model and task (a single run for the Python programs), and scores vary between runs. Some runs were lost to API failures, some models were not accessible through the providers we used for different experiments, and reasoning-effort settings are not directly comparable across providers.
blocks.zh: 这是一次为期三天的短跑,从最初的帖子出现后的第二天开始,所以我们只复制了其中的一些实验,其余的依靠他人的审计. 该代码主要由克劳德·奥普斯·5.5和GPT-6 Astra编写,我们评价的同为模范家庭,尚未独立审查. 大部分结果来自每个模型和任务从1到5跑(Python程序的单跑),得分因运行而异. 一些运行丢失了API故障,一些模型无法通过我们用于不同实验的提供者访问,推理-努力设置在提供者之间没有直接的可比性.

blocks.en: The models are proprietary and may change, so our results describe the versions available in November 2026. All the networks we studied are small, and we tested only one fuzzy task, so whether these abilities extend further remains open. The post’s networks and logs are now public, so future models may have seen them. Finally, the restrictions in the decompilation experiment were instructions, not enforced limits, although another agent later verified that these were not breached.
blocks.zh: 这些模型是专有的,可能会改变,因此我们的结果描述了2026年11月可用的版本. 我们所研究的网络都是小的,我们只测试了一个模糊的任务,所以这些能力是否进一步扩大,仍然保持开放. 博客的网络和日志现已公开, 最后,编译实验中的限制是指示,而不是强制限制,尽管后来另一名代理人证实没有违反这些限制。
